description:
Delete your review (and its score) for a fragrance. This cannot be undone. Confirm with the user first, then call with `confirmed: true`; without it nothing is deleted.

See also: `user_review_upsert` · `user_get_reviews`.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user has approved deleting the review

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

name: user_review_delete
